_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fsi#17 -- rule confirmed, Signal FALSIFIED, and the recommended fix shown not to be one. Upstream fsi_fp_mono_ss_ga_ga.4C.yaml (structuresplit) already declares a Dirichlet on DNODE 2, the structure side of the FSI interface, with all ONOFF entries 0. Turning them on aborts before time step 1 with a boxed banner headed 'DIRICHLET BOUNDARY CONDITIONS ON SLAVE SIDE OF FSI INTERFACE' containing 'The slave side of the interface is not allowed to carry Dirichlet boundary conditions.' and 'SLAVE   = STRUCTURE', from fsi/src/monolithic/model_evaluator/4C_fsi_monolithicstructuresplit.cpp line 131. The claimed sentence 'slave node carries Dirichlet' appears nowhere and the claimed file name 4C_fsi_monolithic_structuresplit.cpp (extra underscore) does not exist. The entry's fix -- switch to iter_monolithicfluidsplit -- also aborts, with the same banner from 4C_fsi_monolithicfluidsplit.cpp line 135 and 'SLAVE   = FLUID', because this deck's fluid interface nodes sit inside a domain-wide DESIGN VOL DIRICH with ONOFF [0,1,1,0]; a fourth control arm proves that is not an artefact of the structural edit, since the UNMODIFIED deck with only COUPALGO swapped fails identically (FIXCONTROL_TIME_STEPS_RUN=0, FIXCONTROL_SAME_BANNER=1). The real constraint is that whichever field is the slave must have a Dirichlet-free interface. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, git 89519cfe76).
expect_in_output: DIRICHLET BOUNDARY CONDITIONS ON SLAVE SIDE OF FSI INTERFACE
The slave side of the interface is not allowed to carry Dirichlet boundary conditions.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave the interface Dirichlet switched off, as upstream ships it. The slave-side banner disappears from the structuresplit arm, EXIT_SLAVEDIRICH becomes 0 and SLAVEDIRICH_INTERFACE_FLAGS_ON becomes 0 (both forbidden), so the fixture must go red.
